Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter & Trust Portal access

Hi Ash / Lydia —

Thanks again for the demo earlier — appreciate the time. Quick recap and asks from the security/compliance side so we can move the evaluation forward: 

- Primary asks:
  1) A copy of your most recent SOC 2 Type II report (redacted is fine).
  2) A brief bridge letter/temporary attestation if the Type II period doesn’t fully cover our expected production date.
  3) Access to your trust portal (or a secure link) so our security team can pull attachments and the DDQ responses.

- Vendor questionnaire: Please expect a DDQ (vendor security questionnaire) from us next. Can you confirm the preferred point of contact to receive the questionnaire and any max turnaround time you typically commit to?

- Timeline: If possible, we’d like the report/bridge letter and portal access within 7 business days so our procurement and security review can progress this month. If that’s tight, let me know what’s realistic.

I’ve attached a bridge letter template (for reference) and a short checklist of items we’ll request once portal access is available.

Attachments: Bridge_Letter_Template.docx (DOCX), Intake_Checklist.pdf (PDF)

Next steps: 1) You confirm whether a redacted report is OK; 2) Provide portal invite (or a temporary link) to security@medivance.com; 3) We’ll kick off the DDQ and share a deadline.

Thanks — looping in Marissa and Dylan to help with portal provisioning and procurement questions.

Best,
Irene Choi
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

I’ll attach the redacted SOC when I have the PDF ready. For the bridge letter, we can provide a short attestation within 48 hours if needed.
